title: The Cave of the Cyclops
sub: Harden the stake, blind the giant, escape beneath the rams

fire.hand: Pinch the stake and hold its point in the fire until it glows.
fire.mouse: Drag the stake into the fire and hold it there.
fire.keys: Tab takes the stake, Space holds it in the fire.

eye.hand: Aim at the eye and push your hand toward the screen: thrust!
eye.mouse: Aim at the eye and flick the mouse upward while pressed.

rams.hand: Pinch each man and tuck him under a ram before the giant's hand finds him.
rams.mouse: Drag each man under a ram.
rams.keys: Tab picks a man, Tab again to a ram, Space drops.
